resources.string: Read and reply through WhatsApp Web, in a layout made for a phone rather than a desktop window.
In the WhatsApp app you already use, open Linked devices and scan the code. It is the same companion link a desktop browser would make.
The chat list and the open conversation take turns filling the screen. On a tablet you can turn that off and keep both.
There is no WhatsWeb account and no analytics. Messages still go through WhatsApp, which is a proprietary service.
WhatsWeb is free software. It is not WhatsApp, and it is not affiliated with WhatsApp LLC.
On your phone, open WhatsApp, then Linked devices, then Link a device, and point the camera at this code.
